caption:
Thank you, volleyball,for 15 years of shaping my life in ways I’m only now beginning to understand. It’s surreal to close a chapter that has been part of my identity for so long. I grew up with you. I learned discipline, resilience, confidence, and how to believe in myself because of you. You taught me how to handle pressure, how to rise after failure, and how to give my heart fully to a team.

This final season wasn’t the one I imagined. Getting injured before it even began was devastating, but it also forced me to slow down and see the game from a new perspective. Even from the sidelines, I learned patience, gratitude, and what it truly means to support others and lead without playing.

When I look back on these 15 years, I don’t just see practices and games, I see people. I see the teammates who turned into family, the coaches who believed in me, the friendships that shaped me. Some of the girls I met on the court have grown into the women who will one day stand beside me as my bridesmaids. Volleyball didn’t just give me teammates… it gave me soulmates, sisters, forever people.

I’m thankful for every lesson, even the ones that hurt. The long bus rides filled with laughter, the locker-room talks, the heartbreaks that taught me resilience, the victories that felt like magic, all of it changed me. Volleyball taught me how to lead, how to love something fully, how to fight for what matters, and how to let go when it’s time.

As I step away, I’m not leaving with sadness, but with gratitude. You gave me memories I’ll replay for the rest of my life, friendships that feel like home, and a version of myself I’m proud of. Thank you for raising me, challenging me, and giving me a story I’ll always cherish.

You will always be part of me.🤍

Slide to the end for a surprise😋

the ceremony

Collins, Britton, and Stafford did amazing as our flower girls and ring bearer! It was so perfect and just what we wanted!

caption: “Dedication sees dreams come true” -Kobe Bryant … I’d like to take this opportunity to thank the people and organizations that have given me even an ounce of dedication throughout the last 10 years of my life. Beach Cities Volleyball club where I began my club career, San Gabriel Elite where I made many friends, and Especially Mizuno Long Beach, my volleyball home for the last 6 years. I want to thank all the coaches that have had a hand in helping shape the player I am today. There have been A LOT of people that have taken their time and energy to help make me better and I can’t express my gratitude enough! I’d like to specifically thank Coach Tommy Chaffins for instilling the “standard of excellence” mindset in me everyday Ive been apart of the Redondo Union Volleyball program. To my friends and family who have supported me, have been understanding of my sacrifices , and have encouraged me through all my trials and tribulations, I don’t think you know how much I truly appreciate you because without you my life would not be the same. To every single one of my teammates , whether indoor or on the beach, you’ve helped push me to a new level of growth in one way or another and I’ll always be grateful for that! To my grandparents , Grandma Armida, thank you for inspiring me, motivating me, and loving me through all my flaws and failures. Grandma Mele Faiva and Grandpa Denny, your love and support throughout the years has meant the world to me. I love the three of you so very much and I am extremely grateful to have you in my life! To Ita Estella, Ito Miguel, Grandma Siu, and Pa Aisea, the four of you set the foundation for my opportunities by coming to this country in search of a better life for your family! I am proud to be your great-granddaughter and I will always carry your courage with me! I’d like to thank my sister! Unknowingly, you came in to my life when I needed you the most and you may never understand it but it will be forever something I thank you for! I will always be there for you, my little Koko Bean!

I will continue your legacy on the fight for people dealing with sickle cell, and I promise I'm going to bring more awareness to it. For now on when I step on that field I promise to go 100% every play/drill I do knowing your with me. I love you forever big sis. 🖤
